checks.command: tmp=$(mktemp -d /tmp/ao-gate.XXXXXX); (cd cli && go build -o "$tmp/ao" ./cmd/ao); "$tmp/ao" gate --help >"$tmp/help"; grep -Fq 'ao gate [command]' "$tmp/help"; for child in approve bulk-approve check pending reject run; do grep -Eq "^[[:space:]]+$child([[:space:]]|$)" "$tmp/help"; done; "$tmp/ao" gate approve --help >"$tmp/approve-help"; grep -Fq -- '--note' "$tmp/approve-help"; "$tmp/ao" gate reject --help >"$tmp/reject-help"; grep -Fq -- '--reason' "$tmp/reject-help"; "$tmp/ao" gate bulk-approve --help >"$tmp/bulk-help"; grep -Fq -- '--older-than' "$tmp/bulk-help"; grep -Fq -- '--tier' "$tmp/bulk-help"; "$tmp/ao" gate check --help >"$tmp/check-help"; for flag in fail-fast fast full github-annotations json require-workflow-parity scope workflow-coverage workflow-path; do grep -Fq -- "--$flag" "$tmp/check-help"; done; test "$("$tmp/ao" gate pending --dry-run)" = '[dry-run] Would list pending gate reviews'; test "$("$tmp/ao" gate approve cand-1 --note ok --dry-run)" = '[dry-run] Would approve candidate cand-1 with note: ok'; test "$("$tmp/ao" gate reject cand-1 --reason no --dry-run)" = '[dry-run] Would reject candidate cand-1 with reason: no'; set +e; "$tmp/ao" gate reject cand-1 >"$tmp/out" 2>"$tmp/err"; code=$?; set -e; test "$code" -eq 1; grep -Fq 'required flag(s) "reason" not set' "$tmp/err"; "$tmp/ao" gate run does-not-exist >"$tmp/run"; grep -Fq '"Status":"UNKNOWN"' "$tmp/run"
